title: Batman: The Animated Series
description: Vowing to avenge the murder of his parents, Bruce Wayne devotes his life to wiping out crime in Gotham City as the masked vigilante “Batman”.

episodes.title: S1-E20I've Got Batman in My Basement
S1-E29The Strange Secret of Bruce Wayne
S1-E41If You're So Smart, Why Aren't You Rich?

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x1
episodes_data.description: When Catwoman infiltrates the underground headquarters of the terrorists, both she and Batman are captured and left to die as victims of a viral plague.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x2
episodes_data.description: When a vicious bat creature known as Man-Bat, starts terrorizing Gotham City, everyone mistakenly thinks that Batman is the culprit. Batman must find out who the mysterious Man-Bat is and clear his own name.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x3
episodes_data.description: Brilliant cryogenics expert Dr. Victor Fries is transformed into Mr. Freeze, a vengeful creature who can only survive in subzero temperatures.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x4
episodes_data.description: A popular actor renowned for his ability to play any part has a terrible secret--he's addicted to a strange chemical formula that enables him to alter his facial features without makeup.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x5
episodes_data.description: Clayface learns that the man responsible for his disfigurement is to appear on TV, promoting a skin conditioner containing the same chemical that deformed him.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x6
episodes_data.description: An aging Mob boss learns his drug dealings have contributed to his son's drug addiction.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x7
episodes_data.description: When a timid accountant accidentally runs afoul of the Joker, he promises the Joker anything if the villain will only let him go.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x8
episodes_data.description: When Catwoman infiltrates the underground headquarters of the terrorists, both she and Batman are captured and left to die as victims of a viral plague.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x9
episodes_data.description: When District Attorney Harvey Dent is poisoned after a dinner date, Batman makes the horrifying discovery that his date was Poison Ivy, a plant-obsessed villainess.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x10
episodes_data.description: A horrifying villain named Scarecrow spreads fear gas and wreaks havoc at Gotham State University.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x11
episodes_data.description: The Joker infiltrates the birthday party of Mayor Hill's son in order to plant a bomb.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x12
episodes_data.description: Batman's friend, Dr. Leslie Thompkins, is taken prisoner by a ruthless land developer after she uncovers his devious plans.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x13
episodes_data.description: Bullock's account of a botched sting operation is so at odds with the other officers' testimony that the police investigator suspends everyone involved.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x14
episodes_data.description: When a maniacally punctilious man faces financial ruin because of attorney Hamilton Hill, he transforms into the devious Clock King and swears revenge on Hill, now the mayor of Gotham.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x15
episodes_data.description: The Joker employs a lethal mind-altering laughing gas to transform the citizens of Gotham into total fools.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x16
episodes_data.description: Alfred and his friend, Maggie Paige, visit a health spa that is actually run by the nefarious Poison Ivy.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x17
episodes_data.description: District Attorney Harvey Dent hides a deep dark secret--he has a second personality, Big Bad Harv, a tough gangster.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x18
episodes_data.description: Two-Face, the former Harvey Dent, begins an aggressive campaign against his hated rival, Rupert Thorne.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x19
episodes_data.description: The Scarecrow uses a fear chemical triggered by adrenaline on Gotham's greatest athletes, then bets against them to reap the winnings.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x20
episodes_data.description: After the Penguin sprays Batman with nerve gas, a 12-year-old boy rescues the unconscious hero and hides him in his basement.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x21
episodes_data.description: Batman suspects that an imprisoned Detective Bullock may be innocent after he is arrested for murder. The real murderer turns out to be Killer Croc, who framed Bullock to get revenge.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x22
episodes_data.description: Bruce begins to worry when all of his wealthy friends join the same Brotherhood group run by Nostromos, a so-called psychic.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x23
episodes_data.description: When men begin disappearing at a bowery, Bruce Wayne decides to go undercover as a worker. He loses his memory after he is attacked, kidnapped and forced to work in a mining camp.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x24
episodes_data.description: The Mad Hatter puts the city of Gotham under his control in an attempt to impress a woman, Alice, with whom he is in love.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x25
episodes_data.description: Batman investigates a theft of bearer bonds intended for the starving people of a poor country.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x26
episodes_data.description: Bruce Wayne wakes up to find that his parents are not dead, he is not Batman, and he's engaged to Selina Kyle!

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x27
episodes_data.description: Batman discovers a gang of forgotten runaways living deep within the Gotham sewer system.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x28
episodes_data.description: When Wayne Enterprises is robbed by a mysterious figure known as the Ninja, Batman and Robin discover that the Ninja is an old nemesis of Bruce Wayne.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x29
episodes_data.description: Dr. Hugo Strange's invention, a machine that reads people's thoughts, leads him to discover that Bruce is Batman.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x30
episodes_data.description: When a genetic engineer produces a man-cat hybrid, he kidnaps Selina Kyle to provide his creation with a mate.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x31
episodes_data.description: Batman must thwart the Scarecrow's plan to poison Gotham's water supply with a chemical that induces hallucinations.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x32
episodes_data.description: Batman connects recent bombings in Gotham to an episode of an old television series featuring his favorite boyhood hero, the 'Gray Ghost.'

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x33
episodes_data.description: Selina Kyle uncovers a plot to infect stray animals with a deadly disease that will be transmitted to the human population.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x34
episodes_data.description: On the anniversary of the death of Bruce's parents, Batman expresses doubts about whether or not he should continue his one-man war against crime.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x35
episodes_data.description: While hiding from the police, Batman's deadliest enemies exchange stories about their mutual nemesis--Batman.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x36
episodes_data.description: Professor Milo tries to use an old friend of Bruce Wayne's, Anthony Romulus, to destroy him after Milo injects Romulus with a serum that changes him into a wolf.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x37
episodes_data.description: When a man-sized bat ransacks Gotham harbor, Batman suspects that Dr. Kirk Langstrom is drinking his Man-Bat formula again.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x38
episodes_data.description: The Joker kidnaps three prominent citizens during Christmas and challenges Batman to find him before midnight.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x39
episodes_data.description: Karl Rossum, owner of Cyberton Labs has been replacing important authority figures with robot look-alikes. Batman invites a young woman to dinner, not knowing that she is a robot as well.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x40
episodes_data.description: Batman escapes from being attacked by his own Batcomputer, which was sabatoged by HARDAC. He now seeks to get back Gordon, Hill and Bullock, who have all been replaced with robots.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x41
episodes_data.description: When Edward Nygma's greedy boss unjustly fires genius him, Nygma seeks revenge in a new guise--as the Riddler!

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x42
episodes_data.description: When a billionaire builds a casino called the Joker's Wild, the Joker breaks out of Arkham Asylum to destroy it.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x43
episodes_data.description: A confused robot that believes he is Batman causes problems for the real Dark Knight.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x44
episodes_data.description: Batman investigates a notorious global crime cartel, The Society of Shadows, which has begun to operate in Gotham City.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x45
episodes_data.description: To prove that he has a superior mind, the Riddler lures Batman into a contest inside a virtual reality computer game.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x46
episodes_data.description: The Joker becomes enraged when the Gotham copyright office rejects his demand for a copyright for his grinning Joker fish.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x47
episodes_data.description: Harley Quinn has broken off with the Joker and teams up with Poison Ivy. Together they wreck havoc on Gotham and now Joker wants a piece of the action.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x48
episodes_data.description: While engaged in a high-speed chase, the Penguin's gang escapes and the Batmobile is virtually demolished.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x49
episodes_data.description: Sidney Debris, a small-time mobster, earns the hatred of all of Batman's enemies when he claims to have accidentally killed Batman during a brawl.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x50
episodes_data.description: When glamorous female magician Zatanna is framed for a robbery during her act, Batman comes to her defense.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x51
episodes_data.description: After learning the name of an extortion ringleader, Batman mysteriously refuses to let Robin continue the investigation with him.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x52
episodes_data.description: Veronica Vreeland, a socialite desperate to create a novel party, makes the mistake of inviting the Penguin as her guest of honor.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x53
episodes_data.description: Despite Batman's orders not to, Robin pursues Tony Zucco, the criminal who was responsible for the death of Robin's parents.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x54
episodes_data.description: Bruce Wayne is temporarily blinded when the Penguin steals a new police helicopter with weaponry developed by WayneTech.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x55
episodes_data.description: Bruce Wayne and Alfred travel to Japan to help Bruce's old martial arts teacher, Sensei Yoru.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x56
episodes_data.description: After a fortune disappears from a gem exposition, Batman investigates. He discovers that the crime may have been committed by an invisible man, an ex-con named Lloyd Ventris.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x57
episodes_data.description: When Robin is mysteriously abducted, Batman's search leads him to meet Ra's Al Ghul, leader of The Society of Shadows, whose daughter, Talia, has also been kidnapped.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x58
episodes_data.description: Batman discovers Ra's Al Ghul's plan to flood Earth with chemicals and return it to a lush, green planet--which will destroy all life that now exists!

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x59
episodes_data.description: Batman investigates a series of baffling crimes and discovers that the crime czar is a wooden dummy, manipulated by a mild-mannered man called the Ventriloquist.

episodes_data.title: Batman: The Animated Series 1x60
episodes_data.description: Believing he's the reincarnation of Zeus, a mad shipping magnate mounts a stolen electron cannon atop his penthouse to shoot 'lightning bolts' at the 'wicked mortals' below.
